Game Overview

Retro Shot is a pixel game built around pilot red and blue ships in tandem, battling waves of quirky alien invaders with retro-inspired charm. Uncover hidden Easter eggs and relive the nostalgia as vintage game melodies and elements pulsate through each level. Achieve high scores and unlock badges in this delightful two-player arcade adventure!

How to Play

Getting started in Retro Shot doesn't take long to learn. Pilot red and blue ships in tandem, battling waves of quirky alien invaders with retro-inspired charm. Uncover hidden Easter eggs and relive the nostalgia as vintage game melodies and elements pulsate through each level. Achieve high scores and unlock badges in this delightful two-player arcade adventure!
